data.content_ref: inline:Parameterize the grounded extension by a school policy that selects which warrant-carriages count as attack edges, and make the skeptical fixpoint return not a single extension but a compact representation of the family of extensions as the policy ranges over a finite policy lattice. Determinism is preserved per policy, the policy-dependent function becomes auditable, and cost stays polynomial if the lattice has bounded width. Criticizable because the family may not be monotone in the policy order, so the compact representation may degrade to a full truth table.
